name: unslop-kit
description: Millon15's reply contract as a Russian doll over pstack's unslop and umputun's writing-style — pass 1 unslop-kit:unslop cuts the AI tells from the wording, pass 2 review:writing-style pins every claim to an exact reference and a flat verdict, pass 3 unslop-formatting lays the reply out as figure-paragraphs (English Check first, TL;DR, then per paragraph: emoji claim line, two prose sentences, a captioned hand-drawn ASCII visual, at most one small numeric table, a 2-7 line blockquote receipt ledger, --- separators, no nested lists, every line hard-wrapped at 120 columns). A SessionStart hook loads the skill, strictly OPT-IN: silent until the user writes 1 to ~/.claude/unslop-kit.mode or exports UNSLOP_HOOK=1 (interactive sessions only; headless/SDK runs always skipped — the contract formats human-facing text; force = everywhere, for A/B tests). Installing the plugin alone changes nothing. Pass 1 is the kit's own unslop-kit:unslop, poteto's 31-pattern unslop body vendored and kept model-invocable (upstream pstack:unslop is user-invocation-only since cursor/plugins PR #300); scripts/sync-unslop.sh re-vendors it. Requires review@umputun-cc-thingz for pass 2 (abridged checklist without it). Personal taste — install at user scope.
